title: Review: Salvador, the sertão and the African heritage of the Northeast
goal: Review Salvador, Candomblé and capoeira, the sertão, Palmares and the debate on race, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: contrast markers, para que, si hubiera + habría, volver a, debido a and a raíz de

items: I can review what I learned about Bahia and the Northeast.
I can use contrast markers, *para que*, past hypotheticals, *volver a* and formal causes.
I can say who explains what about Palmares and the quota law.
I can set one idea about Salvador against another with *en cambio*, *por el contrario*, *al contrario*, *no obstante* and *ahora bien* (review).
I can say what something is for with *para que* + subjunctive, about Candomblé and capoeira (review).
I can say what would have happened in a different past with *si hubiera* + participle and *habría* + participle, about the sertão (review).
I can say that something happened again with *volver a* + infinitive, about Palmares and Zumbi (review).
I can explain a cause in a formal way with *debido a* and *a raíz de*, about race and equality in Brazil (review).
sections.title: Can you do this?
